ability.name: Ultra Stack
ability.note: Ultra Beast. Until the end of this Pokémon's first battle after moving to the field, the Blue Attacks of your Steel-type Pokémon are not lost from the effects of Abilities or Z-Moves. The added damage and number of persistent turns of Attack effects of this Pokémon are additively increased for each Pokémon in the Ultra Space.

wheel.name: Trick Room
wheel.note: For 5 turns, the Gold Attacks of all Pokémon become Misses, the MP of Pokémon that have MP 3 or higher become 1, and the MP of Pokémon that have MP 1 or lower becomes 3 (MP-Increasing or MP-decreasing effects from markers are applied after this).

wheel.name: Gyro Ball
wheel.note: Deals + 30 damage if the battle opponent's MP is higher than this Pokémon's MP.
